text: The current level: one.

text: And the checks that give level two: consent, a MyID check and a phone check, all in the mobile bank.

text: So the app does not say no; it shows Aziz the way up.

text: The first check is this screen of text: the consent gate.

text: The first part is the data that MyID reads from the state records: his names, his date and place of birth, his personal identification number, gender, citizenship, nationality, document data, registered addresses and phone number.
